nodes.natural_language: For positive real numbers a, b, c, such that $3 \leq ab+bc+ca$, show that $3/\sqrt{2} \leq a/\sqrt{a+b} + b/\sqrt{b+c} + c/\sqrt{c+a}$.
nodes.statement: For positive real numbers a, b, c, such that $3 \leq ab+bc+ca$, show that $3/\sqrt{2} \leq a/\sqrt{a+b} + b/\sqrt{b+c} + c/\sqrt{c+a}$.
